title: Model comparison and architect impact
summary: The compiler can now compare two models and name each declaration that was added, removed or changed, down to the part that changed. Every prove records which operations passed and the hashes their proof rests on: the operation, its thing and the things it reaches. architect impact reads that record against today's blueprint, so a change shows exactly which proofs no longer hold.
proves: After a prove, loosening allowance.spend's budget shows exactly stale allowance.spend while grant, revoke, get and create stay proven. Adding allowance.list shows stale none, with list unproven.
